device_label: 8 mm SPH MZM, high-Tg side-chain polymer on 40 nm silicon strip
electrode_metal: gold strip-line electrodes (signal line); aluminum bottom electrode, 1 um
substrate: silicon wafer with 2 um oxide and 1 um aluminum bottom electrode
cladding: sol-gel SiO2, 3 um top and 3 um bottom
epitaxy_or_stack: Layer stack bottom to top: silicon wafer with 2 um oxide; 1 um aluminum bottom electrode; 3 um sol-gel SiO2; 40 nm PECVD silicon strip core, 4 um wide, e-beam patterned and SF6 ICP etched; 1 um side-chain EO polymer layer; 3 um sol-gel SiO2; gold strip-line electrodes 8 mm long. TM0 mode, polymer index 1.67, silicon index 3.48, confinement factor in polymer 73.8 percent (simulated, Supplementary Note 1).
modulation_format: OOK 90, 100, 110, 120 Gbit/s (no error floor down to BER 1e-5 for 90-110 Gbit/s); PAM4 88, 104, 112 Gbit/s (44-56 GBd); Nyquist PAM4 160, 184, 200 Gbit/s (80, 92, 100 GBd, roll-off 0.01)
driver: OOK: SHF 12104A pattern generator with SHF 2:1 multiplexer and RF amplifier, 2.0 Vpp; PAM4: Keysight M8196A AWG (92 GSa/s) or M8194A AWG (120 GSa/s, Nyquist) with SHF S804B linear driver, 1.3 Vpp; RF probe, 50 ohm termination
notes: Single device; all numbers from the Nature Communications version of record (cached PDF, 9 pages); the related correction (10.1038/s41467-020-18908-5) and the Supplementary Information are not cached, so Supplementary Notes 1, 2, 3, 5 are not read. Vpi 1.8 V comes from Table 1; text gives the measured Vpi*L of 1.44 V cm at 1.55 um; frequency, wavelength sweep and drive convention of the Vpi measurement are not stated (text calls Vpi a static parameter). Bandwidth: measured 3 dB EO bandwidth around 68 GHz read on a VNA limited to 70 GHz (curve normalized near 0 dB at low frequency, fitted line shown, ripple visible); the 6 dB bandwidth is only 'presumed over 70 GHz' and is not entered. Propagation loss 0.22 dB/mm (2.2 dB/cm) is cited from Supplementary Note 5 and Table 1; no insertion loss, extinction ratio, RF loss, n_RF or optical group index is reported in the main text. Electrode: gold strip line over the arms with a bottom aluminum electrode, G-S-G probe pads (Fig. 1d); Z0 is a design target matched to 50 ohm, not a measured impedance; electrode_type 'other' because no enum fits. In-device n^3 r33 = 1021 pm/V at 1.55 um (author-reported), Tg 172 C, poling 300-400 V near Tg. Energy per bit: authors compute Wbit = (Vpp/2)^2/(B R); 42 fJ/bit is the 200 Gbit/s Nyquist PAM4 point at 1.3 Vpp and 50 ohm (drive_vpp_v 1.3); the same formula gives 151 fJ/bit at 56 Gbit/s OOK, 1.3 Vpp and about 200 fJ/bit at 100 Gbit/s OOK, 2.0 Vpp. Load energy only, not driver energy. Data: 100 Gbit/s OOK eye Q 7.3, 120 Gbit/s OOK Q 5.4 (Fig. 2); 160 and 184 Gbit/s Nyquist PAM4 below pre-HD-FEC (3.8e-3) and pre-KP4-FEC (2.2e-4), 200 Gbit/s below pre-HD-FEC only (Fig. 3g). Temperature (not a separate row, only link performance was measured): OOK 56 Gbit/s Q drops under 0.5 dB from 25 to 110 C, 100 and 110 Gbit/s under 2.5 dB; 200 Gbit/s PAM4 BER rises under one order of magnitude 22-110 C; 100 Gbit/s BER curves show negligible power penalty after 100 h at 90 C (Figs. 4, 5). temperature_class left empty because the static Vpi and bandwidth temperatures are not stated. Internal inconsistency: loss-efficiency product is 3.6 V dB in the text (p.6) but 3.2 V dB in Table 1 (p.7); 0.22 dB/mm x 14.4 V mm gives about 3.2 V dB. Not entered: loss-efficiency product, BVR (38 GHz/V), Tg, r33.

device_label: 280 um SOH MZM, SOXD-100, multi-level doping
il_onchip_includes: two 2x2 MMI couplers (0.4 dB), strip-to-slot and slot-to-strip converters (0.8 dB), 3 mm access strip waveguide (0.6 dB), slot-waveguide phase shifter (0.9 dB, by subtraction)
il_onchip_excludes: grating couplers (removed with a reference structure); fiber-to-chip edge-coupler loss (about 3 dB per interface in the data experiment)
cladding: SOXD-100 organic electro-optic material in a local opening of the top oxide (TOX); not encapsulated or cross-linked
epitaxy_or_stack: Silicon slot waveguide on SOI: rails nominally 240 nm wide and 220 nm high, slot 160 nm, slab 90 nm (design); TEM of a raw device gives rail height 205 nm, rail width 250 nm at the BOX interface (caption: about 230 nm), slab 75 nm, slot 130 nm at the base and about 160 nm average, sidewall angle about 10 deg, about 220 nm deep trench into the BOX; rails weakly n-doped (width of weakly doped region 340 nm), n+ and n++ slabs and contacts; SOXD-100 organic electro-optic material (index 1.8) deposited into a 5 um wide top-oxide opening; arm length imbalance 40 um; 320 um long RF line; push-pull poling via floating ground electrodes
modulation_format: PAM4 up to 204 GBd (408 Gbit/s) and 192 GBd (384 Gbit/s); PAM6 up to 176 GBd (455 Gbit/s), highest below the 20 percent SD-FEC limit 180 GBd (465 Gbit/s) or 184 GBd (476 Gbit/s) as stated in different places; PAM8 176 GBd (528 Gbit/s); all measured BER below the 20 percent SD-FEC limit at the quoted maxima
driver: Keysight M8199B AWG (80 GHz 6 dB bandwidth) with SHF T850B RF amplifier, 20 cm cable, 110 GHz MPI Titan probe, 50 ohm termination, MMSE predistortion; Finisar BPDV4120R 90 GHz photodiode behind an EDFA; Keysight UXR1104A 256 GSa/s oscilloscope
notes: Single device. All numbers from the publisher-formatted KIT repository copy of the JLT article (17 PDF pages, 2026 IEEE notice; license not verifiable from the copy or from Crossref, so redistribution stays restricted_local_only). Vpi 2.4 V measured, 0.67 V mm reported (stored as 0.067 V cm); measurement frequency and wavelength of the Vpi value not stated; MZM in push-pull (Appendix, p.15). Bandwidth: 3 dB 74 GHz and 6 dB beyond 110 GHz from the EO transfer function normalized to 70 kHz, smoothed with a 10 GHz moving average, calibrated 110 GHz photodiode, probe and cables removed, 50 ohm termination, measured to 110 GHz (Fig. 3c); no gate voltage is mentioned. The simulated response (Fig. 3c) is not entered. On-chip IL 2.7 dB at 1550 nm from fringe fits of a 40 um imbalanced MZM, grating coupler removed; phase-shifter loss 0.9 dB (author deduction by subtraction, Table I) equals 3.2 dB/mm over 0.28 mm, stored as 32 dB/cm with derived basis. ER 38 dB from the same spectrum (static). Z0 about 49.2 ohm is the real part of the simulated line impedance (frequency not stated); RF line S21 -5.5 dB at 110 GHz over the 320 um line, S11 below -15 dB to 110 GHz (measured, not converted to dB/cm). Author-derived: field-interaction factor 0.185 (simulated, TEM geometry), in-device r33 158 pm/V; nOEO 1.8. Geometry cells: rib width 240 nm is the design value (TEM 250 nm at base or about 230 nm per caption), slab 75 nm and sidewall angle about 10 deg are TEM values of a raw device; the 3 um BOX appears only in the generic platform schematic Fig. 1c and is not entered. Data experiment at 1556 nm, 13 dBm laser (not on-chip power), 1.7 dBm fiber output power, drive voltage not stated; BER examples: PAM4 192 GBd 4.8e-3, PAM6 176 GBd 1.9e-2, PAM8 176 GBd 3.4e-2 (electrical back-to-back 2.2e-2). Net data rates by authors from FEC implementations of ref. [59]: 412.5 Gbit/s at 160 GBd PAM8 (line rate 480 Gbit/s), 410 Gbit/s at 176 GBd PAM8, 375.9 Gbit/s PAM6 176 GBd, 356.5 Gbit/s PAM4 192 GBd. PAM6 maximum symbol rate is stated as 180 GBd (abstract, summary, 465 Gbit/s) and as 184 GBd (Sec. IV, 476 Gbit/s); max_baud uses the PAM4 value 204 GBd. Foundry not named, so foundry_or_fab is empty. Not reported: RF Vpi, n_RF, optical group index, energy per bit, drive amplitude, on-chip optical input power, signal-electrode width and thickness, doping levels.

epitaxy_or_stack: Silicon slot waveguide on SOI: device layer 220 nm, slot 120 nm, 3 um buried oxide; two-level doped slabs; coplanar GSG line; organic EO material in the slot (not named for these devices); de-embedding used a second device 500 um long
notes: Source: arXiv v1 (2001.02642v1, 27 pages); the Optics Express version of record is not cached, so its numbers are not claimed. Equivalent-circuit modelling paper: the measured device is a 750 um SOH MZM terminated with 50 ohm, small-signal EOE response biased at the 3 dB point, normalized to 40 MHz, photodiode and probe de-embedded (Fig. 5). Bandwidths are read from the marker positions of Fig. 5(b) (three repeat measurements, spread stated in the row note); the model curves in the same figure (simulated) are not entered. EO material, operating wavelength, Vpi, insertion loss, extinction ratio, electrode metal and dimensions of the measured devices are not stated in this version; the Sec. 2 slot-width range, 'in excess of 300 pm/V' and JRD1 mention refer to other work. Z0 about 50 ohm is the authors' analytic high-frequency limit sqrt(L'TL/(C'S+C'TL)) (p.9), derived, no frequency stated; the measured Re{Z0} in Fig. 3(a) falls steeply at low frequency and then rises with frequency, with a clear gate dependence (figure read, approx), so the same 50 ohm on both gate rows is an asymptote, not a measured value; ng_opt 3.2 from a numerical mode solver. RF loss is the amplitude coefficient alpha (1/mm) read from Fig. 4 at 50 GHz and converted with 8.686 x 10 mm/cm x alpha; the reading frequency was chosen here, reading uncertainty about 10 percent. Circuit fit (Table 1): R'TL 13 ohm/mm, L'TL 414 pH/mm, C'TL 130 fF/mm, G'S,bulk 2.76 mS/mm, g'S,acc 145 uS/(V mm), C'S 160 fF/mm. Gate 0 V: slab conductance G'S 2.8 S/m (Fig. 4a). 3 dB and 6 dB bandwidths read from Fig. 5(b) markers at 0 V: about 2-4 GHz and about 4-6.5 GHz over the three repeats (central values 3 and 5 GHz); model prediction not entered. RF loss alpha about 0.2 /mm (flat above a few GHz) gives about 17 dB/cm. Bandwidth rule: central value of the three repeat markers (median, rounded).

notes: Simulated design example, not a fabricated device. The authors' Eq. Projection from the doping-optimization study (Figs. 11, 12), not a device and not a single computed operating point. Authors state a 0.5 mm SOH modulator could reach f6dB,EOE above 100 GHz with doping-related optical excess loss below 0.1 dB, and, 'using highly efficient EO polymers [16]', a pi-voltage below 1 V (p.21; Summary); that bound rests on an external material assumption, is not computed in the paper, and is not entered (vpi_dc_v empty).
